footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to LATAM Airlines: after $3.6M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 11.2% to $14.3B in 2025. Gross margin was 29.2%, versus 25.5% a year earlier, and operating income rose 51.6% to $2.3B, a 16.4% margin.
Net income rose 49.4% to $1.5B, or $0.00 per share. Operating cash flow was $3.7B and free cash flow $2.0B, versus $1.8B; LATAM Airlines returned $1.2B through dividends and buybacks.
